snippet.title: Blood & Canvas: Bareknuckle Boxing - Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Wishlist on Steam:  
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4982860/Blood__Canvas_Bareknuckle_Boxing/

Join the community:  
https://discord.gg/uMRV76qMC

About the Game
Step into the role of an up-and-coming bareknuckle fighter and climb from illegal underground fights to the biggest stage in bareknuckle boxing. Every victory earns money to improve your abilities, upgrade your gym, and prepare for tougher opponents—but every cut and bruise results in cumulative damage and brings you one step closer to retirement.
